item.title: Linux Systems & Environment: Kernel primitives, daemon management, shell pipelines, and system internals
item.description:
Harnessing the Linux operating system as a development and server backbone through automation scripting, process inspection, and permission hardening.
Architecture Focus: POSIX Process Lifecycles, Daemons & Automated Pipelines Key Topics: Linux Shell Automation & Pipeline Data Processing • System Services, Daemons & Log Diagnostics (journalctl) • File Permissions (chmod/chown), ACLs, and Sudoers • Process Lifecycle (kill, ps, top, htop, fork/exec) Protocols: Bash / Shell Scripting, systemd, POSIX, SSH Hardening, Process Management, Cron
Code Implementation (bash): sudo systemctl status backend-node.service journalctl -u backend-node.service -f -n 50 ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -n 10

item.title: [LAB-SYS-03] Linux Server Hardening & SSH Key Enforcement
item.description:
Configuring non-root administrative users, enforcing Ed25519 SSH keys, disabling password authentication, and setting up basic UFW firewall rules.
Domain: System Hardening | Status: Active Lab Tools: Ubuntu Server, SSH (Ed25519), UFW / iptables, systemd Key Takeaway: Minimized attack surface on Linux hosts by restricting open ports and eliminating brute-force vectors.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): sudo ufw default deny incoming sudo ufw default allow outgoing sudo ufw allow OpenSSH sudo ufw enable && sudo ufw status verbose

item.title: Linux Process Architecture & Virtual File System (/proc, /sys)
item.description:
